browsers.name: lifecycle
browsers.command:
python3 ../test/ci_run_commands.py \
  --check 'browser unit tests' 'node --test unit/*.test.js' \
  --check 'software visibility' 'GLOB2_TEST_RENDERER=software xvfb-run -a npx playwright test --config visibility.config.js' \
  --check 'WebGL visibility' 'GLOB2_TEST_RENDERER=webgl2 xvfb-run -a npx playwright test --config visibility.config.js'

browsers.name: chromium webgl2 responsive and startup
browsers.command: xvfb-run -a npx playwright test responsive-presentation.spec.js runtime-build.spec.js --project=chromium

browsers.name: webkit
browsers.command: xvfb-run -a npx playwright test runtime-build.spec.js threading.spec.js viewport.spec.js responsive-presentation.spec.js campaign-editor-storage.spec.js colony-skins.spec.js skin-assets.spec.js recording.spec.js studio.spec.js --project=webkit

browsers.name: webkit scripting
browsers.command: xvfb-run -a npx playwright test determinism.spec.js --project=webkit --grep='shared scripting corpus'

browsers.name: firefox
browsers.command: GLOB2_FIREFOX_HEADED=1 xvfb-run -a npx playwright test runtime-build.spec.js threading.spec.js viewport.spec.js responsive-presentation.spec.js campaign-editor-storage.spec.js colony-skins.spec.js skin-assets.spec.js recording.spec.js studio.spec.js --project=firefox

browsers.name: firefox WSS and simulation
browsers.command: GLOB2_FIREFOX_HEADED=1 xvfb-run -a npx playwright test determinism.spec.js --project=firefox --grep='WebAssembly produces|WebAssembly verifies|Markets V2|runtime catalog'

browsers.name: webkit WSS and simulation
browsers.command: xvfb-run -a npx playwright test determinism.spec.js --project=webkit --grep='WebAssembly produces|WebAssembly verifies|Markets V2|runtime catalog'

browsers.name: firefox scripting
browsers.command: GLOB2_FIREFOX_HEADED=1 xvfb-run -a npx playwright test determinism.spec.js --project=firefox --grep='shared scripting corpus'

browsers.name: chromium threaded colony skins
browsers.command: GLOB2_SKIN_TEST_THREADS=threaded xvfb-run -a npx playwright test colony-skins.spec.js skin-assets.spec.js --project=chromium

browsers.name: firefox replay import and reload
browsers.command: GLOB2_FIREFOX_HEADED=1 xvfb-run -a npx playwright test import.spec.js session-reload.spec.js --project=firefox --grep='imports a complete replay|an active replay'

browsers.name: webkit replay import and reload
browsers.command: xvfb-run -a npx playwright test import.spec.js session-reload.spec.js --project=webkit --grep='imports a complete replay|an active replay'
